context: Hina and Sho complain about the heat playfully.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Sho, it's really so hot, isn't it?
lines.style: Bright, direct address. High child energy with genuine observation underneath. Eager to share the discovery with him. Soft, unselfconscious warmth throughout.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet agreement, matter-of-fact. Small voice, no complaint—just stating what is. Warm agreement with her. Genuine and unperformed.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: I want to find somewhere cool.
lines.style: Bright wish-thinking aloud. Child's directness about desire without apology. Warm invitation underneath. Eyes on Sho for his reaction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Soft proposal. Small but certain. Reaches toward her with the suggestion. Genuine warmth, no performance. The 'together' lands gently.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Contentment settles into her voice. Closing thought, not rushed. Quiet wonder at the simple rightness of the moment. Warm, complete.
